rows.name: trp-operon-synthesis-probability
rows.description: Per-transcription-unit actual synthesis probability. This is the quantity the model's TrpR fold-change terms actually modify - repression enters as a delta_prob on synthesis probability - so it is the most direct readout of the mechanism under study, and it is verified emittable by the baseline composite.

rows.name: tf-binding-per-tu
rows.description: Bound transcription factors per transcription unit. Distinguishes "the repressor is gone" from "the repressor is present but its term is small", which B5 needs.

rows.name: trp-operon-cistron-counts
rows.description: Per-cistron mRNA counts for the trp operon and the wider regulon candidates. ASPIRATIONAL: the baseline composite as configured emits five listener groups (atp, mass, ribosome_data, rna_synth_prob, rnap_data) and none carries per-cistron mRNA counts, so this path is NOT currently emittable. Kept because it is the readout the question naturally wants; reaching it requires enabling the RNA-counts listener on the composite.

rows.name: total-transcription-initiation
rows.description: Total RNAP initiations per tick - the denominator behind every actual_rna_synth_prob share. Carried as a DIAGNOSTIC, not a correction: a same-gene between-arm ratio cancels any global normalization, so this only needs checking if the arms differ in total transcription, which matched conditions make unlikely.

rows.name: trp-intracellular-pool
rows.description: Intracellular TRP[c] pool. Route A's build failure is an assertion on this quantity's ParCa-time counterpart, so the run-time pool is the observable that connects the two routes.
